DocsMaskTr.exCreditCardNote2: American Express kartları 34 veya 37 ile başlar. Bu durumda kart numarası 4-6-5 gruplu maskeye geçer ve CVV alanı otomatik olarak 3 yerine 4 haneye uzar (resolveMask).
DocsMaskTr.exCreditCardNote3: Kartta validator: 'luhn', son kullanmada validator: 'expiry' yerleşiktir.
DocsMaskTr.exCardDescription: Kredi / banka kartı numarası. Visa, Mastercard, Amex ve Troy BIN’lerine göre tip algılanır; Amex’te maske otomatik değişir.

DocsMaskTr.exCardCustomDesc: BIN’e göre kart tipini UI’da göstermek için.
DocsMaskTr.exExpiryDescription: MM/YY formatı. Ay geçerli olmalı ve tarih geçmiş olmamalıdır.

DocsMaskTr.exCvvDescription: 3 haneli güvenlik kodu. Aynı şemada card alanı varsa Amex için 4 haneye çıkar.
DocsMaskTr.exCvvNote1: resolveMask, şemadaki card alanına bakarak CVV_3 / CVV_4 seçer.
DocsMaskTr.exCvvNote3: Entegre kullanım için Kredi kartı formu örneğine bakın.
DocsMaskTr.exCurrencyDescription: Binlik / ondalık ayırıcılarla para formatı. Formda ham değer noktalı ondalıktır (örn. 1234.56).

DocsMaskTr.exIbanDescription: TR önekli IBAN. Görüntüde TR sabittir; form değeri yalnızca rakamlardır. Mod-97 doğrulaması vardır.
DocsMaskTr.exTcknDescription: 11 haneli Türkiye Cumhuriyeti kimlik numarası; algoritmik doğrulama.
DocsMaskTr.exTaxNumberDescription: 10 haneli vergi kimlik numarası; VKN algoritması ile doğrulanır.
DocsMaskTr.exPhoneNote1: Yerleşik format doğrulayıcısı yoktur; yalnızca maske uygulanır.
DocsMaskTr.exEmailDescription: İzin verilen karakterler ve e-posta doğrulaması.
DocsMaskTr.exAlphaDescription: Harf ve Türkçe karakterler; ardışık boşluklar sadeleştirilir.
DocsMaskTr.exUsernameDescription: Slugify: küçük harf, aksan temizleme, boşluk → tire.
DocsMaskTr.exDateNote1: dateFormat varsayılanı 'DMY'. MDY / YMD ile değiştirilebilir.

DocsMaskEn.commonBuiltinValidator: Built-in validator: {validator} — produces a form error when an invalid value is entered.
DocsMaskEn.commonScopeLead: The documentation covers the full package surface:
DocsMaskEn.introPageDescription: Type-safe input formatting compatible with React Hook Form — cards, phone, IBAN, and more.
DocsMaskEn.introHeaderDescription: A lightweight input formatting library that stays in sync with React Hook Form.
DocsMaskEn.introLead: It provides a single useViraMask() hook for card numbers, phone, IBAN, currency, and custom masks. The form state holds the raw (unmasked) value while the input shows the formatted display.
DocsMaskEn.introGettingStartedBody: Install the package. See the <examples>examples</examples> page for live mask demos.
DocsMaskEn.introWhyLight: <bold>Lightweight</bold> — zero runtime dependencies; React and React Hook Form as peers.
DocsMaskEn.introWhyRhf: <bold>RHF-first</bold> — integrates with register / setValue; display and raw values stay separated.
DocsMaskEn.introWhyPresets: <bold>Smart presets</bold> — card (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Troy), CVV, TCKN, IBAN, currency, and more.
DocsMaskEn.useViraMaskPageDescription: Hook API: schema, display vs raw value, and fields spread onto inputs.
DocsMaskEn.useViraMaskHeaderDescription: Mask multiple fields with one hook. Schema field names match form fields.
DocsMaskEn.useViraMaskSchemaLead: Three notations are valid for each field:
DocsMaskEn.useViraMaskSchemaFooter: See the <examples>examples</examples> page for every built-in mask. For masks from scratch, see <custom>custom mask</custom>.
DocsMaskEn.useViraMaskReturnLead: useViraMask() returns a MaskField for each schema key. Spread it directly onto the input:
DocsMaskEn.useViraMaskReturnRaw: rawValue — raw value kept in the form
DocsMaskEn.useViraMaskRhfRegister: Each field is registered; validation runs under validate.maskFormat.
DocsMaskEn.useViraMaskRhfSetValue: setValue writes the raw value to the form (shouldValidate / shouldDirty / shouldTouch).
DocsMaskEn.useViraMaskRhfValidate: Validation runs only when validate: true and the value is non-empty — details on the validation page.
DocsMaskEn.customMaskPageDescription: Mask syntax (9 / a / *), MaskOptions, and dynamic masks with resolveMask.
DocsMaskEn.customMaskHeaderDescription: When a built-in mask isn’t enough, use your own mask string and MaskOptions fields.
DocsMaskEn.customMaskSyntaxLead: Special tokens in the mask string:
DocsMaskEn.customMaskOptDisplayPrefix: displayPrefix — shown but not written to the raw value (like TR on IBAN)
DocsMaskEn.customMaskOptPreset: preset — override on top of a built-in mask
DocsMaskEn.customMaskResolveBody: For dynamic masks, resolveMask(value, allValues, schema) returns a new mask string (or undefined). Card (Amex) and CVV presets use this — they update the mask by looking at sibling fields.
DocsMaskEn.validationPageDescription: Built-in validators, custom functions, and error messages.
DocsMaskEn.validationHeaderDescription: Built-in validators on presets or your own function — wired into React Hook Form errors.
DocsMaskEn.validationBuiltinLead: Enabled with validate: true and a validator key. Empty fields are not validated.
DocsMaskEn.validationExpiry: MMYY — month 1–12, not a past date
DocsMaskEn.validationImportNote: Functions can also be imported directly: validateLuhn, validateTCKN, validateIBAN, the VALIDATORS map, etc.
DocsMaskEn.validationMessageBody: On failed validation, errorMessage is returned; otherwise RHF gets false. Read errors via form.formState.errors.
DocsMaskEn.validationFooter: For type definitions see <types>types</types>; for live demos see <examples>examples</examples>.
DocsMaskEn.helpersPageDescription: Formatting and helper functions you can use outside the hook.
DocsMaskEn.helpersHeaderDescription: Formatting and helper functions you can use without the hook.
DocsMaskEn.helpersApplyMask: Applies a pattern to a raw value
DocsMaskEn.helpersUnmask: Extracts data characters from a masked value
DocsMaskEn.helpersStripMask: Keeps only data slots at the locked mask step
DocsMaskEn.helpersCardBody: getCardType(cardNumber) works from BIN prefixes (Visa 4, Amex 34/37, Troy 9792…).
DocsMaskEn.helpersRefsBody: mergeRefs(...refs) — merge an RHF register ref with a local ref. The hook uses this internally; it’s also useful on your own controlled inputs.
DocsMaskEn.typesPageDescription: Exported TypeScript types and the MaskPreset union.
DocsMaskEn.typesHeaderDescription: TypeScript types in the package exports.
DocsMaskEn.typesMaskSchema: MaskSchema<T> — form field name → preset string | MaskOptions
DocsMaskEn.typesMaskField: MaskField — props spread onto a single input
DocsMaskEn.uiLibrariesPageDescription: Mask is UI-agnostic — the same pattern with shadcn, Ant Design, Chakra, and plain inputs.
DocsMaskEn.uiLibrariesHeaderDescription: Mask binds to any input component. The examples below use the same hook API.
DocsMaskEn.uiLibrariesLead: useViraMask() returns field props. Spread them onto the input; card.value is the formatted display, card.rawValue is the raw form value.
DocsMaskEn.uiLibrariesShadcnBody: The live demos on this site also use shadcn Input. Props are spread directly:
DocsMaskEn.uiLibrariesAntBody: antd Input accepts native input props — same pattern:
DocsMaskEn.examplesPageDescription: Live previews of every preset. Click one for details and customization.
DocsMaskEn.examplesHeaderDescription: Live previews of every preset. Click a title for details, code, and customization.
DocsMaskEn.examplesDetailFooter: For the hook API see <hook>useViraMask()</hook>; for custom masks see <custom>custom mask</custom>.
DocsMaskEn.exCreditCardDescription: Card number, expiry, and CVV together. When Amex is entered, CVV automatically expands to 4 digits.
DocsMaskEn.exCreditCardNote1: Uses card + expiry + cvv in the same schema.
DocsMaskEn.exCreditCardNote2: American Express cards start with 34 or 37. The card number then switches to a 4-6-5 grouped mask and the CVV field automatically grows from 3 to 4 digits (resolveMask).
DocsMaskEn.exCreditCardNote3: Card has built-in validator: 'luhn'; expiry has validator: 'expiry'.
DocsMaskEn.exCardDescription: Credit / debit card number. Type is detected from Visa, Mastercard, Amex, and Troy BINs; the mask changes automatically for Amex.
DocsMaskEn.exCardNote1: Numbers starting with 34/37 use the Amex mask (4-6-5).
DocsMaskEn.exCardNote2: The form value is unmasked raw digits.
DocsMaskEn.exCardNote3: Listen for visa / mastercard / amex / troy via onCardTypeChange.
DocsMaskEn.exCardCustomDesc: Show the card type in the UI based on BIN.
DocsMaskEn.exExpiryDescription: MM/YY format. Month must be valid and the date must not be in the past.
DocsMaskEn.exExpiryNote1: Invalid months or past dates are rejected.
DocsMaskEn.exCvvDescription: 3-digit security code. Expands to 4 digits for Amex when a card field is in the same schema.
DocsMaskEn.exCvvNote1: resolveMask inspects the schema’s card field to pick CVV_3 / CVV_4.
DocsMaskEn.exCvvNote2: Without a card field, the default is 3 digits.
DocsMaskEn.exCvvNote3: See the Credit card form example for integrated usage.
DocsMaskEn.exCvvCustomDesc: CVV length is tied to card type.
DocsMaskEn.exCurrencyDescription: Money format with thousand / decimal separators. The form keeps a raw dotted decimal (e.g. 1234.56).
DocsMaskEn.exCurrencyNote1: Defaults: precision 2, decimal ',', thousand '.', empty symbol, prefix.
DocsMaskEn.exCurrencyNote2: Uses the currency strategy instead of a pattern mask.
DocsMaskEn.exIbanDescription: TR-prefixed IBAN. TR is fixed in the display; the form value is digits only. Mod-97 validation is included.
DocsMaskEn.exIbanNote1: displayPrefix: 'TR' is not written into the raw value.
DocsMaskEn.exTcknDescription: 11-digit Turkish national identity number with algorithmic validation.
DocsMaskEn.exTaxNumberDescription: 10-digit tax identification number; validated with the VKN algorithm.
DocsMaskEn.exPhoneNote1: No built-in format validator; only the mask is applied.
DocsMaskEn.exPhoneCustomDesc: Add your own validator if you want.
DocsMaskEn.exAlphaDescription: Letters and Turkish characters; consecutive spaces are collapsed.
DocsMaskEn.exUsernameDescription: Slugify: lowercase, strip accents, spaces → hyphens.
DocsMaskEn.exDateNote1: dateFormat defaults to 'DMY'. Change with MDY / YMD.

DocsPasswordEn.commonScopeLead: The documentation covers the full package surface:
DocsPasswordEn.commonStartCli: Also available during Start CLI setup (npx virastack@latest --tools password).
DocsPasswordEn.introPageDescription: An accessible, headless password visibility toggle with ViraStack Password — a single useViraPassword() hook.
DocsPasswordEn.introHeaderDescription: An accessible, customizable password visibility toggle — a headless React hook.
DocsPasswordEn.introLead: Show/hide password fields are easy to get wrong: missing ARIA, a button that submits the form, disabled sync issues, prop clashes. useViraPassword() solves these in one hook — markup and styling stay yours.
DocsPasswordEn.introGettingStartedBody: Install the package. See the <examples>examples</examples> page for live demos.
DocsPasswordEn.introWhyHeadless: <bold>Headless</bold> — prop bag only; same API with shadcn, Ant Design, or a native input.
DocsPasswordEn.introWhyDefaults: <bold>Smart defaults</bold> — Eye / EyeOff SVG icons included.
DocsPasswordEn.introWhyMerge: Safe merge — on* handlers chain, className merges; disabled / readOnly lock the toggle.
DocsPasswordEn.useViraPasswordPageDescription: Hook API: options, inputProps / btnProps, visibility state, and programmatic control.
DocsPasswordEn.useViraPasswordHeaderDescription: Manage input type and the visibility button with one hook. Props are spread directly.
DocsPasswordEn.useViraPasswordOptionsFooter: For icons and styling see <custom>customization</custom>; for ARIA see <a11y>accessibility</a11y>.
DocsPasswordEn.useViraPasswordMergeLead: User props are applied after base props. Most keys can be overridden; these are merged:
DocsPasswordEn.useViraPasswordMergeOn: on* event handlers run in order (base first, then user)
DocsPasswordEn.useViraPasswordMergeClass: className strings are joined with a space
DocsPasswordEn.accessibilityPageDescription: ARIA labels, type=button, aria-controls, and screen-reader support — out of the box.
DocsPasswordEn.accessibilityHeaderDescription: Ready ARIA for screen-reader and keyboard users — no extra configuration.
DocsPasswordEn.accessibilityLead: The hook produces accessible attributes for the button and input. Markup close to the default output:
DocsPasswordEn.accessibilityAriaFooter: Core helpers are on the <helpers>helpers</helpers> page.
DocsPasswordEn.accessibilityButtonBody: The toggle always gets type="button". That prevents accidental form submit — keep this value when using your own button component (don’t override it).
DocsPasswordEn.accessibilityIdsControls: The button’s aria-controls binds to the same id — multiple password fields work safely on one page.
DocsPasswordEn.customizationPageDescription: Custom icons, text, input/button props, and style merging.
DocsPasswordEn.customizationHeaderDescription: Icons, text, styling, and lock states — fit your design system with the headless API.
DocsPasswordEn.customizationIconsBody: The icons field accepts ReactNode — SVG, component, or plain text. show renders when the password is hidden, hide when visible.
DocsPasswordEn.customizationIconsFooter: Default icons can also be imported from the <helpers>helpers</helpers> page. More examples: <iconsEx>custom icons</iconsEx>, <textEx>custom text</textEx>.
DocsPasswordEn.customizationPropsBody: name, autoComplete, className, and extra handlers are merged via options:
DocsPasswordEn.customizationPropsFooter: Merge rules are on the <hook>useViraPassword()</hook> page. Example: <mergeEx>Prop merge</mergeEx>.
DocsPasswordEn.customizationStateBody: In both cases visibility can’t change — the button is disabled, and toggle / setVisible are no-ops.
DocsPasswordEn.customizationCodeDisabledComment: Input + button disabled; toggle / setVisible no-op
DocsPasswordEn.customizationCodeReadOnlyComment: Input readOnly; button disabled; toggle / setVisible no-op
DocsPasswordEn.helpersPageDescription: Core helpers, default icons, and mergeProps.
DocsPasswordEn.helpersHeaderDescription: Core helpers, icons, and mergeProps you can use outside the hook.
DocsPasswordEn.helpersCoreLead: Framework-agnostic functions — usable without React state:
DocsPasswordEn.helpersIconsBody: Default EyeIcon / EyeOffIcon (16×16 SVG, currentColor). The hook renders them; you can import them in your own UI too.
DocsPasswordEn.helpersMergeBody: The merger the hook uses is exported: it chains on* handlers, joins className strings, and later values win for other keys. Handy for manual merge in controlled components.
DocsPasswordEn.typesHeaderDescription: TypeScript types in the package exports.
DocsPasswordEn.uiLibrariesPageDescription: Password is UI-agnostic — the same pattern with shadcn, Ant Design, Chakra, and plain inputs.
DocsPasswordEn.uiLibrariesHeaderDescription: Password binds to any input / button component. The examples below use the same hook API.
DocsPasswordEn.uiLibrariesLead: useViraPassword() returns a prop bag. Spread onto input and button; the icon is in btnProps.children.
DocsPasswordEn.uiLibrariesLead2: The package only manages visibility logic and accessible props — markup and styling stay yours. shadcn/Tailwind, Ant Design (its own CSS + style/className), or Chakra (style props) don’t matter; the same hook binds to every UI kit.
DocsPasswordEn.uiLibrariesShadcnBody: The live demos on this site also use shadcn Input + Button:
DocsPasswordEn.examplesPageDescription: Live previews. Click one for details and code.
DocsPasswordEn.examplesHeaderDescription: Live previews. Click a title for details and code.
DocsPasswordEn.examplesDetailFooter: For the hook API see <hook>useViraPassword()</hook>; for styling and icons see <custom>customization</custom>.
DocsPasswordEn.exBasicDescription: The simplest show/hide usage with default icons and ARIA.
DocsPasswordEn.exBasicNote1: inputProps and btnProps are spread directly.
DocsPasswordEn.exBasicNote2: Default visibility is false — the input starts as type=password.
DocsPasswordEn.exBasicNote3: Eye icons ship with the package; no extra setup.
DocsPasswordEn.exCustomIconsDescription: Use your own SVG or components via icons.show / icons.hide.
DocsPasswordEn.exCustomIconsNote1: show: when the password is hidden (show button).
DocsPasswordEn.exCustomIconsNote2: hide: when the password is visible (hide button).
DocsPasswordEn.exCustomIconsNote3: icons accepts ReactNode — icon, text, or any JSX.
DocsPasswordEn.exCustomTextDescription: Use text like “Show” / “Hide” instead of icons — icons is still ReactNode.
DocsPasswordEn.exCustomTextNote1: There is no separate text API; icons.show / icons.hide can be a string or JSX.
DocsPasswordEn.exCustomTextNote2: show: label when the password is hidden.
DocsPasswordEn.exCustomTextNote3: hide: label when the password is visible.
DocsPasswordEn.exDisabledDescription: When disabled or readOnly, the toggle locks; visibility can’t change.
DocsPasswordEn.exDisabledNote1: disabled: true → input and button disabled.
DocsPasswordEn.exDisabledNote2: readOnly: true → input readOnly, button disabled.
DocsPasswordEn.exPropMergeDescription: Merge name, autoComplete, className, and handlers via inputProps and btnProps.
DocsPasswordEn.exPropMergeNote1: User props are merged with base props.
DocsPasswordEn.exPropMergeNote2: on* handlers are chained; className is joined.
DocsPasswordEn.exPropMergeNote3: This example is not a form library — it shows prop-merge behavior.
DocsPasswordEn.exProgrammaticDescription: Control visibility from code with isVisible, toggle, and setVisible.
DocsPasswordEn.exProgrammaticNote1: The hook return includes isVisible, toggle(), and setVisible(visible).
DocsPasswordEn.exProgrammaticNote2: Set the initial state with defaultVisible.
DocsPasswordEn.exProgrammaticNote3: After blur or submit you can hide again with setVisible(false).
DocsPasswordEn.exProgrammaticNote4: When disabled / readOnly, the programmatic API is also a no-op.
